limits: A paid-plan spending example, not equivalent product capabilities or storage allocations.
The server is in a similar CPU/memory class to the controlled fixture, not a measured provider capacity guarantee.
The local storage budget assumes at most 100 GiB total app data, with approximately 3 times the snapshot size available as free verification workspace, plus growth margin.
The 500 GiB remote repository budget is capacity for retained encrypted snapshots, not unlimited history or a promise to back up 500 GiB of live data.
Operators must make the budgeted storage available to Docker app and backup volumes and monitor actual usage.
Taxes, migration, setup, extra transfer, domains, additional retention, and growth are excluded.
Five-year chart holds seats, prices, storage, workload, and admin effort constant; it is a scenario, not a forecast.
Free commercial plans, bundles, discounts, and existing hardware change the calculation.
No paid provider account was created for this illustration.

controlled_test_comparison.scope: Controlled fixture resource class, not a benchmark of the referenced provider plan.
